title: Senior Network Engineer – Technical Security, Cloud Networking & SASE
description:
Senior Network Engineer – Technical Security, Cloud Networking & SASE - Data Center & Fortinet. Designing, implementing, securing and supporting enterprise network infrastructure across on-premises, stores, warehouses, factories, cloud, remote-access and hybrid environments.
Responsibilities:
- Manage LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, segmentation
- Design secure network architectures aligned with Zero Trust; next-generation firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, web security, NAC
- Work with NOC and SOC teams on threat detection and response; SIEM integration
- Design and support networking across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud
- Design, implement and operate SASE: ZTNA, SWG, CASB, FWaaS, SD-WAN, DLP
- Senior escalation point for critical incidents; root-cause analysis; on-call 24x7 rotation where required
- Automation to improve network configuration
Required Technical Skills:
- TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, VXLAN, MPLS and SD-WAN, IPv4/IPv6, load balancing, packet analysis
- Next-generation firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, segmentation, Zero Trust, NAC, SIEM/SOC integration
- AWS / Azure / GCP networking, VPC/VNet, cloud firewalls, hybrid-cloud networking, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, CASB, FWaaS, DLP

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer – Network & Security
description:
Senior Network & Security Engineer to design, implement, manage and support enterprise network and security infrastructure. Qualification: Engineering Degree/Diploma (Computers/Electronics). Certification: CCNA, CCNP Security, PCNSC, NSC 4. Experience: 12+ Years.
Requirements:
- Spine-leaf and three-tier architecture, core, distribution and access switching, leased lines and MPLS with high availability
- Palo Alto Firewall (HA, security policies, QoS, NAT, virtual routers, zones)
- FortiGate perimeter firewall (HA, VDOM, IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, LDAP)
- Cisco Wireless Controllers 9800 with ISE 802.1X
- Cisco ISE and SDA fabric; Cisco DNA Center (DNAC); Cisco ACI fabric
- VMware NSX, vSphere and VMware Cloud Director
- Infoblox DNS/DHCP/IPAM; Cisco IPS
- F5 BIG-IP LTM, GTM and APM
- Disaster recovery planning and testing; 24/7 production support and on-call

title: Sr. Network Engineer
description:
Senior Network Engineer: enterprise LAN, WAN, Data Center, WLAN, SD-WAN, HCI, ACI and network security. L2/L3 support, RCA, migrations, project leadership, mentoring junior engineers.
Responsibilities:
- Routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers; firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN and NAC solutions
- Network upgrades, migrations, redundancy, high availability and disaster recovery
- Wireless controllers, access points and WLAN services
Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or Networking
- Cisco ACI, HCI, firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS, NAC, load-balancing highly desirable
Preferred Certifications: Cisco CCNP / CCIE, CCNA, Cisco DevNet, Fortinet / Palo Alto / Check Point certifications, VMware / HCI certifications, ITIL

title: Fortinet Network Engineer
description:
Fortinet Network Engineer for clients across the UAE and GCC (IT services / MSSP).
Required Qualifications:
- 5-6+ years network security engineering focused on Fortinet
- FortiGate firewalls, HA, VPNs, IPS, web filtering, application control; routing, switching, VLANs, NAT
- Fortinet certifications required: NSE 4 minimum; NSE 5-7 strongly preferred
- SOC/MSS operations, incident response and change management
- SIEM integration, IAM/PAM, cloud network security (AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus
- CCNA/CCNP is a plus; UAE residency/work eligibility preferred
Responsibilities: FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch, FortiAP; firewall policies, VPN IPSec/SSL, NAT, HA; network security hardening; L2/L3 support.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Senior Network Engineer with around 5 years experience in enterprise networking, routing, switching, firewall and network security.
Requirements:
- Minimum 5 years networking experience; CCNA/CCNP; valid UAE driving license
- Cisco, Aruba and Alcatel switches; Fortinet firewalls, VPNs, NAT
- VLAN, STP, OSPF, BGP, ACL, link aggregation; troubleshooting; onsite and remote customer support

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Network & Security SME (presales/architecture) to design and deliver enterprise network and security solutions for customers in the UAE.
Responsibilities:
- Design LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, WLAN, data center architectures (HLD/LLD); Zero Trust, micro-segmentation, NAC, VPN
- Lead presales: workshops, BOMs, sizing, proposals, RFP/RFI, PoCs
- Security architecture reviews aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, PCI-DSS, NESA
Technical expertise: OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS, VXLAN EVPN; SD-WAN Cisco, Fortinet, Versa, VeloCloud; Cisco Nexus, Arista, Juniper; Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point, Juniper SRX; Netskope, Zscaler, Prisma Access; Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass, Forescout; Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel; Ansible, Terraform, Python.
Requirements: 2-3 years of UAE experience in network and security; Arabic speakers preferred.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Network & Systems Administrator: network and server infrastructure, firewalls, switches, routers, VPNs, Windows Server (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP), CCTV, IP PABX telephony.
Requirements:
- 3-5 years network and systems administration; firewalls (SonicWall, Fortinet, Cisco ASA); Windows Server 2016/2019/2022; CCTV; PABX
- CCNA, CCNP, MCSA or Fortinet NSE a plus. Native Hindi speaker is a must.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Design, implement, secure and maintain complex enterprise network infrastructures. Advanced configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco and Fortinet network and security solutions: routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, wireless.
- Design, deploy and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN and data center network using Cisco and Fortinet
- Cisco routers, switches (Catalyst, Nexus); Fortinet FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer; Cisco ASA, Cisco ISE
Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer or Electronics. Active Fortinet NSE 4, NSE 5 and NSE 7, and preferably CCNP Enterprise. Preferably PCNSE.
